coverage_explanation: Exercises all three individual colors, all three two-color combinations, all colors together, and a repeated command after intervening changes. Checks every channel after each command, including removal of previously selected colors and active-LOW polarity.
assumptions: The explicit common-anode circuit overrides bench LED defaults: R=4, G=3, B=2; LOW fully illuminates a channel and HIGH turns it off.
Each newline-terminated comma-separated list specifies the current selected colors, consistent with the requirement that input colors and pin states line up perfectly.
Serial uses the disclosed 9600 baud. All injected commands end in newline; no behavior for incomplete or malformed commands is required.
Initial LED color is unspecified and is not checked. No bench wiring defaults are needed.
